notes: Governing documents: systemwide APM 760/715/710/133 (cover Senate faculty) and the campus PPM 230-15 (effective 2016-07-01) and PPM 230-10 (effective 2010-07-01). Under V3c both the campus and system provisions are coded; where they give the same benefit they are linked concurrent_with so the more generous counts (c1/c3, c4/c5, c7/c8, c12/c14, c13/c15). The PPM 230-15 version note records the decision that the campus two-quarter figure is a cap on the combined period, not a grant; APM 760-28-a sets the ASMD lengths: coded as leave_limits (22 weeks) and the APM lengths on c4.

Version: the saved APM 760 pages carry 'Rev. 1/1/06' except 760-30 (Rev. 9/1/15); the version note dates the document Rev. 9/1/15 and in force on 2018-02-28. The campus PPM 230-15 describes a Parental Bonding Leave (12 weeks, 6 paid) not in the saved APM 760; the campus policy is the institution's own policy (V3c), not a conflict.

Calendar: quarter system ('a full academic year (three quarters)'; 'Academic-year appointees ... from the first day of the fall quarter through the last day of the spring quarter'); no term length stated, so calendar.kind = quarter, and the term length follows R8's order. Quarter alternatives of 'quarter (or semester)' lengths coded (R8).

Member's path (U8): a ladder-rank Senate faculty member with two years of service: two quarters of ASMD total for a birth mother (full-time appointment of at least one academic year), FMLA/CFRA eligibility met, paid medical leave band of two quarters (less than 10 years).

Birth parent chain: pregnancy disability / childbearing leave up to 4 months (c2; first 6 weeks paid at base salary, c1 = c3, within c2) inside ASMD totalling two quarters (c4 = c5; c1 within c4) -> parental bonding leave 12 weeks, 6 paid (c6, also_available after ASMD); combined ASMD + childbearing + bonding capped at two quarters (22 weeks); FMLA (c9) concurrent from the start of c2; CFRA 12 workweeks (c10) consecutive_after c2 (S1a); APM parental leave up to one year (c7 = c8) consecutive_after c2, concurrent with CFRA; paid medical leave two quarters (c12 with pay c13 within; c14/c15) also_available with c2, then discretionary unpaid medical leave up to a year (c16) consecutive_after c12; all leaves and ASMD capped at one year (52 weeks).

Non-birth parent chain: ASMD one quarter (c4 = c5) -> parental bonding leave 12 weeks, 6 paid (c6, also_available after ASMD), combined cap 22 weeks; FMLA (c9) and CFRA (c10) concurrent with the bonding leave and the APM parental leave (c7 = c8, up to one year); discretionary paid FMLA (c11) within c9; aggregate cap one year.

ASMD relief level: ladder-rank faculty receive 'either partial or full relief from teaching'; full relief is required in the quarter of a childbearing (APM) or childbearing/bonding (PPM) leave. Teaching coded relieved; the partial option noted in relief_note.

Not coded as components: deferral of personnel or academic review (APM 760-31, PPM 230-15 II.G: a review deferral, not leave, pay, relief or tenure-clock extension) and the no-disadvantage clause (APM 133-17-i); health-coverage continuation and reinstatement terms (recorded in the leaves' notes); sabbatical, leave in lieu of sabbatical, governmental service, military, professional meeting, research, change in work location, extended leave and jury duty (not usable for a birth); APM 710-24-e leave with or without pay under APM 758/759 for appointees not eligible for paid medical leave (a cross-reference only, another group).

Documents cited but not saved: APM 730 (Vacation), APM 758 and APM 759 (Other Leaves With/Without Pay), APM 711 (Reasonable Accommodation for Academic Appointees with Disabilities), APM 740 (Sabbatical), APM 220 (Professor Series, part-time), APM 670 (Health Sciences Compensation Plan), APM 110-14/110-15 (faculty definition), APM 080, APM 145, APM 150, APM 210-1, APM 700, APM 720, APM 750, APM 751, APM 752, APM 025, APM 390, APM 230-20, APM 600 Appendix 2, PPM 365 and 365-13, Health Sciences School Implementation Procedures, the UC Short-Term Disability Plan and Supplemental Disability Plan, the UCSD HR Catastrophic Leave Donation Program policy, the Family Accommodations Reporting (FAR) form.

Statute verification: FMLA 12 workweeks (29 U.S.C. 2612(a)(1)), CFRA 12 workweeks and its addition to PDL (Cal. Gov. Code 12945.2(a), (p)), PDL not to exceed four months (12945(a)(1)) checked against the saved texts, which are current (2026) versions.
